experiences.name: Meia Praia Beach Day
experiences.description: Spend a relaxing day at Meia Praia, one of the longest and most beautiful beaches in the Algarve, just a short distance from Lagos. Enjoy golden sands, calm waters perfect for swimming, and beachside bars serving fresh seafood and cold drinks. Rent a sun lounger and umbrella for ultimate comfort.

experiences.name: Ponta da Piedade Coastal Kayaking
experiences.description: Paddle through the stunning golden limestone sea stacks, grottos, and hidden sea caves of Ponta da Piedade, just south of Lagos city center. Guided kayak tours depart from Lagos beach and take you through some of the most dramatic coastal scenery in the Algarve. Snorkeling gear is often included.

experiences.name: Algarve Wine Tasting at Quinta dos Vales
experiences.description: Visit one of the Algarve's most celebrated wineries, Quinta dos Vales, located in the Estômbar area near Lagoa. Enjoy a guided tour of the vineyards and wine cellar followed by a tasting of their award-winning red, white, and rosé wines made from local grape varieties like Negra Mole and Arinto. Stunning sculpture gardens add a cultural touch.

experiences.name: Praia do Camilo Sunset Visit
experiences.description: Descend the wooden staircase to the secluded and breathtaking Praia do Camilo, a small cove framed by dramatic ochre cliffs just minutes from central Lagos. The beach is ideal for swimming in crystal-clear turquoise water and is especially magical at golden hour. Combine with a cliffside walk for panoramic views.

experiences.name: Lagos Old Town Food and Culture Walk
experiences.description: Explore the historic walled center of Lagos on a guided food and culture walking tour departing from the city center near Rua Dr. Faria e Silva. Discover the 15th-century Slave Market, Igreja de Santo António, and the vibrant Mercado de Lagos. Sample local delicacies including cataplana seafood stew, pastel de nata, and regional Algarve wines at traditional tascas.
